canVerify: Actual native N, learned grimoire, fire/water and waits create a nonburning hot reaction-owned source. Three F5/F6-matched cases observe live owner Examine through keyboard/pile selection, one paid approach and wait, source/target-specific canonical Heat records plus observed HP, and escape while source steam remains. No positive temperature, density, HP or resistance is assigned.
cannotVerify: Source prop and grimoire are explicit factory fixtures; bounded generated-lane travel is a shortcut, not natural acquisition. Each negative repeats source creation then changes only source temperature to ambient or removes SteamEffect. Attempt records alone do not prove landed damage; exact canonical hit and HP pairs do. Unit tests cover immunity/veto/multibody/callback/save behavior. Images need independent warning/feedback inspection; this does not establish universal thermal propagation or global balance.
